'''Lerantha Lake''' was a lake located in the [[Kaamos Territory]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Held back by [[Lerantha Dam]], Lerantha Lake was one of the two origin points of the [[Fornaak River]] along with the [[Fornaak Falls]], and [[House of Thul|House Thul]] had a [[Thul droid factory|droid factory]] built on the north side of the lake that could be reached by a bridge that spanned the lake.
